build.name: Build production artifacts
build.run:
$downloadArgs = @("--version", $env:SDKWORK_PACKAGE_VERSION, "--release-tag", $env:SDKWORK_RELEASE_TAG)
if ($env:CLAWROUTER_DOWNLOAD_CDN_BASE_URL) {
  $downloadArgs += @("--cdn-base-url", $env:CLAWROUTER_DOWNLOAD_CDN_BASE_URL)
}
node scripts/update-claw-router-downloads.mjs @downloadArgs
node scripts/build-claw-router-production.mjs
cargo build -p sdkwork-claw-installer --bin clawrouterctl --release

stage.name: Stage production files
stage.run:
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$stage = Join-Path (Get-Location) "dist/install-package-staging"
$output = Join-Path (Get-Location) "dist/install-packages"
Remove-Item -LiteralPath $stage -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item -LiteralPath $output -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Join-Path $stage "bin") | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Join-Path $stage "portal") | Out-Null
$suffix = if ($IsWindows) { ".exe" } else { "" }
Copy-Item -LiteralPath "target/release/clawrouter$suffix" -Destination (Join-Path $stage "bin/clawrouter$suffix")
Copy-Item -LiteralPath "target/release/clawrouterctl$suffix" -Destination (Join-Path $stage "bin/clawrouterctl$suffix")
Copy-Item -LiteralPath ".env.release.example" -Destination (Join-Path $stage ".env.release.example")
Copy-Item -LiteralPath "apps/sdkwork-clawrouter-pc/dist" -Destination (Join-Path $stage "portal/dist") -Recurse

package.name: Build selected install package

validate.name: Validate selected install package

sign.name: Sign artifacts placeholder
sign.run: Write-Host "Signing policy is configured by release environment for $env:SDKWORK_PACKAGE_ID"

sbom.name: SBOM placeholder
sbom.run: Write-Host "SBOM generation is not required for $env:SDKWORK_PACKAGE_ID"
